create_symbolic_alchemy_level: create a SymbolicAlchemy environment instance using get_symbolic_alchemy_level with a specified level name and seed
create_fixed_symbolic_alchemy: create a fixed SymbolicAlchemy environment using get_symbolic_alchemy_fixed with pre-defined chemistry and episode items
run_symbolic_alchemy_step: run a step in the SymbolicAlchemy environment by calling step with an integer action and observe the timestep
convert_int_action_to_tuple: convert an integer action to a stone-potion tuple using int_action_to_tuple for slot-based or type-based environments
convert_tuple_action_to_int: convert a stone-potion tuple action back to an integer using tuple_action_to_int for the environment
